papers.paperTitle: Assistant Professor- Biotechnology, Maharashtra Education Services, Gr-A
papers.paperTitleMr: सहाय्यक प्राध्यापक- बायोटेक्नोलॉजी, महाराष्ट्र एज्युकेशन सर्व्हिसेस, गट-अ

topics: Biomolecules and their structure & function: Carbohydrates, Lipids, Proteins including Peptide hormones, Growth hormones, Kinases, Cytokine receptors
Protein Structure & Function: Primary, Secondary, Tertiary & Quaternary Structure, Protein folding
Post translational processing and modifications: Glycosylation, Phosphorylation, acetylation etc.
Protein degradation: Lysosomal & proteosomal, Enzymes-Activity, Regulation & Kinetics
Metabolic & Nutritional Disorders: Carbohydrates, Lipids & Nucleic acids

Metabolomics & Metabolic Engineering: Overview of primary metabolism, Integration of Metabolism, The Metabolome - Metabolic flux, Metabolic flux analysis, Metabolic engineering - Polyketides Synthesis, Xenobiotics
Phytochemistry: Secondary Metabolism pathways & Importance, Secondary Metabolite: structure, classification, properties & Therapeutic importance
Genome Structure and Organization in prokaryotes and eukaryotes: Structure and function of chromatin and nucleosome, C value paradox and genome size, Gene families
DNA Replication: Mechanisms and regulations in prokaryotes and eukaryotes, DNA replication models
DNA Damage & Repair: Types of DNA damage, DNA repair mechanisms-nucleotide excision repair, mismatch repair, recombination repair, double-strand break repair
DNA Recombination: Homologous and site-specific recombination, models for homologous recombination-Holliday junction, NHEJ, Proteins involved in recombination
Mobile DNA elements: Transposons & Retrotransposons
Gene Expression in Prokaryotes and Eukaryotes: Chromatin remodeling, Regulation of transcription, Posttranscriptional processing and transport of RNA, Non coding RNAs
Protein Synthesis, Modifications and Transport: Protein synthesis-Mechanism and Regulation, Genetic code, Transport of proteins, Protein turnover and degradation
Global and regional threats to the environment: Pollution-air, soil, and water
Biotechnology in Remediation: Introduction to bioremediation, Phytoremediation, Bioaugmentation and Biostimulation
Environmental Laws and Policies- International and National
Sustainable development: Sustainability in use of bio-resources
Remote sensing and Environmental Auditing: Environmental Impact Assessment
Cell structure and function in plant and animals
Cell organelles
Cell membrane-Transport across plasma membrane
Cytoskeleton-Structure and function
Extracellular matrix and cell junctions
Cell signaling-communication between cells and environment, Signalling at cell surface, hormones and receptors, intracellular signalling molecules, Signal transduction and second messengers
Cell Cycle and its regulation
Cell differentiation, cell death
Protooncogens, oncogenes and cell transformation and cancer
Tools used in genetic engineering: DNA modifying and degrading enzymes, Transformation and Transfection, cDNA and genomic DNA library
Expression strategies and methods for producing industrially important molecules: Expression vectors in bacteria and eukaryotes, Induced expression-strategies and protocol

Molecular techniques: PCR - design and optimization, Types of PCR-Inverse, Nested, Reverse Transcription-PCR, Hot Start PCR, Quantitative PCR, DNA amplification of specific sequences from a cDNA library, use in diagnosis of diseases
DNA sequencing: Maxam-Gilbert method, Sanger's Dideoxy chain termination method, Automated DNA sequencing method, Human genome sequencing, Genome mapping techniques-physical and genetic
Applications of genetic engineering in human disease diagnosis, agriculture and manufacture of therapeutics, genetically modified organisms
Biosafety regulations, intellectual property rights
Introduction to immune system
Types of Immunity: Innate immunity versus Acquired immunity
Complement system and activation pathways
Structure of antibody molecules, Antigen-Antibody reactions - Applications in Diagnostics
Hypersensitivity
Auto immunity
Transplant immunology
Parasitic immunology
Techniques in molecular immunology: including Hybridoma (Monoclonal antibody), Chimeric antibodies, Phage display
Vaccine development
Manufacturing of immuno-diagnostics and Clinical Trials

Basics in Microbiology: Bacterial Cell Structure and Function, Control of bacterial growth (Sterilization and disinfection), handling pathogens, safety in microbiology laboratory, Metabolic diversity of bacteria, Extremophiles and their adaptations, Pathogenicity and Virulence of Bacteria

Techniques in microbiology: Cultivation, Aerobes, anaerobes and microaerophiles, Pure culture techniques, Differential staining techniques and principles, General strategy used for identification of unknown bacteria, Introduction to Bergey's Manual
Applied microbiology: Pathogenic bacteria and human health, Industrially important microbes, Microbes in food preservation and spoilage

Virology: Introduction to viruses, Classification of viruses (ICTV system, Baltimore system), Viral replication, Viral Diagnosis, Antivirals including therapeutic agents, Vaccines, Viral infections and Epidemiology, Emerging viral diseases, Animals, Poultry and plant viruses
Algal biotechnology: qualitative and quantitative improvement in economically important algae
Fungal biotechnology: qualitative and quantitative improvement in economically important fungi
Micropropagation: Advantages over conventional methods, stages of micropropagation (stage 0 to stage 4), organogenesis, somatic embryogenesis and artificial seeds
In vitro androgenesis and its applications, somatic hybridization, cybridization and their applications
Transgenic plants: experimental methods of transgenesis, production of neutraceuticals, pharmaceuticals, biopesticides

Applications of Transgenic / genetically modified plants: biotic and abiotic stress tolerance, production of secondary metabolites, increase in productivity, molecular farming, plantibodies, vaccines, therapeutic proteins
Agricultural Biotechnology: Crop improvement methods, bioreactors in plant production, Marker assisted selection, Transgenesis for crop improvement
Introduction to tissue culture: Definition, principle and significance, media formulation, sterilization
Various systems of animal tissue cultures: Primary culture, Explant culture, Suspension culture
Cell lines: Definition, establishment and maintenance, normal and established cell lines, cell senescence
Organ culture: Organ transplants, tissue engineering
Measurement of cell growth, storage viability and cytotoxicity, Cell hybridization, Transfection studies
Application of animal cell culture for in vitro testing of drugs, production of viral vaccines and pharmaceutical proteins
Stem cells: adult, embryonic, induced pluripotent stem cells, identification, purification, characterization
Transgenic animals: artificial breeding, in vitro fertilization, embryo transfer technology, artificial insemination
Biosafety issues and Bioethics associated with developing transgenic animals
Introduction to fermentation and Basic aspects of bioengineering
Design of Fermenter/ bioreactors: Stirred tank reactor and non-mechanically agitated bioreactors
Kinetics of operation of bioreactors: Batch, Fed Batch and Continuous processes
Mass transfer, Aeration and agitation of fermentation broth
Fermentation Media, Sterilization and monitoring of process variables, Scale Up and Scale Down
Molecular Engineering: Mutation, Protoplast fusion, parasexual cycle and genetic engineering
Production and Downstream processing: Primary and secondary metabolites, kinetics of growth and product formation
Effluent Disposal strategies used for Textile, dye, dairy, paper and pulp industries
Probiotics, ore leaching, biofuels, Fermentation economics

units.unitTitle: Database Management and Intellectual Property Rights
units.unitTitleMr: डेटाबेस व्यवस्थापन आणि बौद्धिक संपदा हक्क
topics: Database Management: Concept of Database, Organization, Characteristics and types of databases relevant to Biotechnology, Data Management and data mining, Source Documentation, Databases (PubMed, PubChem, OMIM, CTR etc.)
Intellectual Property Rights: Characteristics and Types of Intellectual Properties, Treaties, Conventions, Laws, Acts, agreements pertaining to Biotechnology

Tools of IPRs-patent processing: Patents prerequisites, Biological Patents (Plant, Animal, Microbial), Process and Product patents, Indian and International scenario, Plant varieties and Plant breeders rights, Industrial Designs
